data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- DD4 (partial): Unit test written asserting all generated reviewer agents contain NOT-flag rules heading

## Implementation Steps

Add the following function to `tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh` before the `# ── Run all tests ──` section:

```bash
# ── Test N: built agents contain NOT-flag auto-downgrade rules heading ─────────
#
# RED: no code-reviewer-*.md in plugins/dso/agents/ contains
#      '## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules' yet (T3+T4 add it).
# GREEN: after T3 adds the section and T4 rebuilds all 10 agents, all assertions pass.

test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading() {
    _snapshot_fail

    local agents_dir
    agents_dir="$(git -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents"

    local missing=0
    local agent_file
    for agent_file in "$agents_dir"/code-reviewer-*.md; do
        [ -f "$agent_file" ] || continue
        local agent_name
        agent_name="$(basename "$agent_file")"
        if ! grep -q '^## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules' "$agent_file"; then
            (( missing++ ))
            printf "  missing '## NOT-Flag Auto-Downgrade Rules' in: %s\n" "$agent_name" >&2
        fi
    done
    assert_eq "all_agents_have_not_flag_rules_heading" "0" "$missing"

    assert_pass_if_clean "test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading"
}
```

Add the function call at the bottom of the run section (after test_built_agents_contain_severity_calibration_rubric_heading):
```
test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading
```

Update `.test-index`: append to the existing `plugins/dso/scripts/build-review-agents.sh` entry:
`,tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh [test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading]`

NOTE: T1 must complete first (both T1 and T2 modify .test-index — serialize via dependency).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading function exists in test-build-review-agents.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading' tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh
- [ ] Function uses _snapshot_fail (RED marker mechanism)
  Verify: grep -A5 'test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading' tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh | grep -q '_snapshot_fail'
- [ ] Function includes [ -f "$agent_file" ] || continue guard
  Verify: grep -A15 'test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading' tests/unit/scripts/test-build-review-agents.sh | grep -q '|| continue'
- [ ] .test-index build-review-agents.sh entry has RED marker
  Verify: grep 'build-review-agents.sh' .test-index | grep -q '\[test_built_agents_contain_not_flag_rules_heading\]'
